series.title: Fermi-Hubbard 2D cuprate series
series.excerpt: Second Fermi-Hubbard project page: from the earlier 1D IBM/TDVP validation route to a 2D cuprate-oriented validation ladder with exact 3x3 checks, IBM and Fire Opal diagnostics, and 4x4/6x6 tensor baselines.

articles.title: Fermi-Hubbard 2D cuprate series, part 1: from 1D to 2D
articles.excerpt: The second Fermi-Hubbard series starts by carrying the validation discipline from the earlier 1D IBM/TDVP route into a 2D cuprate-oriented ladder.

articles.title: Fermi-Hubbard 2D cuprate series, part 2: 2D Hubbard, cuprates, and Google/Willow context
articles.short_title: Part 2: 2D Hubbard, cuprates, and Google/Willow context
articles.excerpt: The 2D route is motivated by the one-band Hubbard model as a minimal description of strongly correlated electrons in cuprate-like planes.

articles.title: Fermi-Hubbard 2D cuprate series, part 3: our 3x3 implementation
articles.excerpt: The 3x3 run is not meant to be large-scale cuprate physics. It is the exact validation lab that makes the later hardware results interpretable.

articles.title: Fermi-Hubbard 2D cuprate series, part 4: time evolution and hardware diagnostics
articles.short_title: Part 4: time evolution and hardware diagnostics
articles.excerpt: The 3x3 hardware comparison shows the main diagnostic pattern: Fire Opal is cleaner than direct IBM, but sector survival still falls with time.

articles.title: Fermi-Hubbard 2D cuprate series, part 5: 4x4 hardware and tensor baselines
articles.excerpt: The 4x4 run is where exact ED stops being the comfortable reference route and tensor baselines become necessary.

articles.title: Fermi-Hubbard 2D cuprate series, part 6: 6x6 tensor baseline, IBM diagnostics, and Fire Opal Fez
articles.short_title: Part 6: 6x6 tensor baseline, IBM diagnostics, and Fire Opal Fez
articles.excerpt: The 6x6 step reaches 72 qubits, but the current hardware result is still diagnostic: Fire Opal Fez improves strongly over IBM, while sector survival remains low.
